Name: ITEMLOT_PARAM_ST
Description: Item lots, rolled for enemy drops (ItemLotParam_enemy), map pickups and rewards (ItemLotParam_map). A lot starts at its row ID and continues through ID + 1, + 2 and so on until an ID is missing; each row is one roll and awards at most one of its 8 slots. Slots whose acquisition flag is on are left out of the roll.

Fields.Name: 1 - Item Chance
Fields.Description: Weight of slot 1 in the roll. Chance = this weight / the sum of the weights of the row's rolled slots. A slot with weight 0 (and Accumulate Chance 0) is not rolled. An empty slot with a weight and Item Amount 0 is how retail makes "no drop" (e.g. 985 empty vs 15 item).

Fields.Name: Item Acquisition Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag for every slot without its own flag. While it is on, those slots are left out of the roll, so the row gives nothing more. The awarded item carries this flag. Retail uses it for one-time pickups and unique enemy drops. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Roll Counter Flag
Fields.Description: First of 8 consecutive event flags holding the row's roll counter as a binary number (this flag is bit 0, so up to 255). Each roll of the row adds 1. 0: no counter. Unused by retail ER.

Fields.Name: Item Accumulate Max
Fields.Description: Counter value at which the slots reach their Item Accumulate Chance. 0: the accumulate weights are not used. Unused by retail ER.

Fields.Name: Item Rarity
Fields.Description: Rarity given to the awarded item instead of its own rarity. Results that share an acquisition flag use the highest. −1: the item's own rarity (Custom Weapons: 0).

Fields.Name: New Game+ Variant
Fields.Description: Uses row ID + value × 100,000,000 instead of this row once the playthrough is high enough: 1 always, 2 from NG+, 3 from NG+2 … 8 from NG+7. The variant's own value continues the chain; give it −1 or a higher value (the same value hangs the game). Only for row IDs whose hundred-million digit is 0. 0 or −1: none (all retail rows).

Fields.Name: Can Friendly Phantom Acquire
Fields.Description: Lets a cooperating phantom roll this row; without it the row is skipped for them.

Fields.Name: Can Hostile Phantom Acquire
Fields.Description: Lets a hostile (invading) phantom roll this row; without it the row is skipped for them.
